The observed path then continuously repeats substantially the same ineffective selection action through step 50 without correcting the premise or changing strategy. summary: The sole chain shows the reuse target entering a continuous, unrecovered loop of ineffective file-selection clicks based on the unsupported premise that Olivia_King_CV.pdf was already selected.
